Second, 'merged coverage with reviewed exclusions' has no successful run. [run:run-0001] coverage.read failed because the sources and top parameters were missing. [run:run-0002] veritriage.investigate failed because no artifact paths were given. To rerun coverage.read, use sources=lifo4_fcov.sv plus the lifo4 RTL and the held-out testbench, with top set to the testbench top. I left both failed runs out of tool_runs so they are not read as evidence of closure. The open CDC clocking assumption does not affect this model, because all lifo4 ports are synchronous to clk according to the matrix.
